summary: In this project, we created a book using NASA's two probes' storytelling, to give children a change of perspectives. We think that if we convey the information through the probs' eyes (Surveyor 4 and Ingenuity Mars Helicopter)  children would enjoy this new approach as they get to know to the equipments belonging to NASA on Moon and Mars. Using 2D desings  that our team has created of the Surveyor 4 and Ingenuity Helicopter presents a more friendly feature for children (especially for younger age groups).
details: This project is a decorated kids' book that also includes our original illisturation of Ingenuity Mars Helicopter to help the younger audience have a more friendly impression while learning about these two probes' journey. We are aiming for a way to help kids with learning and spreading awarness about the abondened equipments of NASA in space while making it rather less boring for them by telling the story directly from the tools' mouth, since kids might not find this topic much interesting. We used a free book-creating website (storyjumper) to create this book while the text, cover and images were all written and edited by our team. We sincerly beleive that taking a different approach will help children be more interested in these subjects while teaching them.
